skills.summary: For work tasks (code, data, analysis, research, docs, decks, prompts). Use whenever the user asks you to be ambitious or more ambitious, think bigger, aim higher, go deeper, raise the bar, not settle for the minimal version, do what a top expert would do, or find the goal behind the goal, even when the task looks small (a speed-up, a bug fix, a summary, a prompt to improve).
